bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided public policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration using scikit-learn, examined topic stability across repeated fits, and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used pandas and Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
Ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided company report records and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.
Executed and inspected supplied NLTK tokenization and word-count steps on document samples, and inspected vocabulary examples with guidance before attempting classification.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; executed and inspected supplied notebooks to visualize group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
